about.title: About
about.lead: I'm an AI engineer. I work with language models, RAG, and automation, from prototype to production.

bio.p1: My work is turning LLM prototypes into systems people can use day to day. That includes deterministic LLM programming, RAG, integrations, and automation.
bio.p2: I currently work as an AI engineer at Freedom.AI. I also run MAIB, where I work on AI consulting and automation projects, and completed an AI residency at SENAI/SC.
bio.p3: I write here about Claude Code, LLM programming, and the problems that show up when a project leaves the demo.

items.description: I prefer to test and measure before calling something done. If the result can't be reproduced, there is still work to do.
I show what I built, why I chose that approach, and what went wrong. I don't hide the technical part behind marketing.
I test new tools and ideas, but I don't use something just because it's popular. First I check whether it solves the problem.

journey.heading: Journey
journey.body: In 2026, I won the Airbus Prize with the IGNITE team at the ActInSpace world final in Bordeaux, representing Brazil. In 2025, I placed second at AKCIT. I also completed an AI residency at SENAI/SC and now work at Freedom.AI while running MAIB.
